LESSON: READING FOR COMMUNICATION

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: Reading 2.6 Skimming for information (2 Lessons) By the end of the sub- strand, 
Topic 2.7: Reading for Communication

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading for Communication. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can reading enhance knowledge?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify language structures in reading comprehension
2. appreciate the role of reading for details in communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING FOR COMMUNICATION
This lesson teaches Reading for Communication for Grade 9 GERMAN.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify language structures in reading comprehension
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. appreciate the role of reading for details in communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading for Communication using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading for Communication above.
2. Explain Reading for Communication to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading for Communication.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading for Communication with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading for Communication important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can reading enhance knowledge?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify language structures in reading comprehension
2. appreciate the role of reading for details in communication

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
